description: The data center campus planned from a projected load: IT grows 12 → 24 → 36 MW over 2027, 2030 and 2035 while the utility energizes the 40 MW connection in steps (20 MW until 2030). Genset and battery candidates per period, so the plan says what to build when. Multi-period; tagged for an Energy Hub study.
